name: ClickSyncr for Drip – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator
author: ClickSyncr

sections.description:
ClickSyncr for Drip – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator connects your forms to Drip, so every form submission becomes a subscriber in your Drip campaign: automatically, with no code.

Works with your form builder

  • Contact Form 7
  • WPForms
  • Gravity Forms
  • Ninja Forms
  • Fluent Forms
  • Formidable Forms
  • Forminator

One plugin, one Drip connection. ClickSyncr configures each form right inside the builder you already use, and it connects your forms to 20+ other email marketing platforms too.

“Drip” is a trademark of its respective owner. This plugin is an independent integration and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Drip.

Why you’ll love it

  • Set up in minutes: paste your Drip API token and you’re connected. No developers, no code.
  • Your campaigns load automatically: choose which Drip campaign new subscribers join, right inside the form editor.
  • Map your fields: send names and your Drip custom fields straight from your form.
  • Built-in opt-in: add a consent checkbox and ClickSyncr adds the subscriber when a visitor ticks it, and sends nothing at all when they leave it unticked.
  • Your visitors never wait: the form answers your visitor first, and the subscriber is sent to Drip right after.
  • A setup for every form: each form can sync to a different Drip campaign, with its own field mapping and its own API token, in every supported builder.
  • Sync health at a glance: an admin-bar menu shows every form’s Drip sync counts and the last error, if any.
  • Lightweight and fast: built to WordPress standards, so it never slows your site down.
  • You stay in control: you decide exactly what data is sent to Drip, and to which campaign.

Learn more about the forms to Drip integration.

What you’ll need

  • WordPress 6.7 or higher
  • At least one supported form builder: Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable Forms, or Forminator
  • A Drip account with an API token

Getting your Drip API token

  1. Log in to your Drip account.
  2. Open User settings.
  3. Copy your API token.
  4. Paste it into the ClickSyncr for Drip – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator settings of any form.

Support

Need a hand? Browse the documentation, check the frequently asked questions, or contact us and we’ll be glad to help.

External services

Diagnostic sharing is on by default and can be turned off in the Advanced section of any connected form. It sends software versions, aggregate configuration and delivery counts, and random installation/device identifiers to Signls. It excludes contact/submission values and credentials. See privacy details.

This plugin connects to Drip. When you connect, refresh or open a configured form’s settings, it authenticates with your API token and requests the available campaigns, fields and account settings. A configured form submission sends the email address and the fields you map to your selected destination. A test submission sends the test address and configured fields. Subscription and consent settings determine whether a submission is sent. Drip processes this information under its own terms and privacy policy.

Privacy

ClickSyncr does not set tracking cookies or send visitor IP addresses to a geolocation service. If you map context fields, the mapped page URL, IP address, browser information or submission time is sent to Drip. Optional sender context adds the page, form, time and browser to the site owner’s notification email. API credentials, form settings and sync counters are stored in your WordPress database. Administrators can enable a local diagnostic log with redacted personal data. ClickSyncr does not receive your form submissions.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “ClickSyncr for Drip – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator”.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.

After installation

  1. Edit any form and open its ClickSyncr for Drip – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator settings.
  2. Paste your Drip API token, choose a campaign, and map your fields (email is required).
  3. Save. Every submission now syncs to Drip automatically. Full guidance lives on the ClickSyncr for Drip – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator page.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Drip account?

Yes. You’ll need an active Drip account and an API token to sync your subscribers.

Which form builders are supported?

Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable Forms, and Forminator. At least one of them must be installed and activated.

Where do I find my Drip API token?

Log in to your Drip account. Open User settings. Copy your API token. Then paste it into the form’s Drip settings.

Which fields can I map?

Map your form fields to the email address and the custom fields in your Drip account.

How does the opt-in consent field work?

Pick a consent field (a checkbox, acceptance, or radio) from your form. When a visitor ticks it, the subscriber is sent to Drip; if they leave it unticked, nothing is sent at all, so nobody is added without agreeing. Leave it as “None” to use the subscriber status you chose for the form.

Can I use different settings for different forms?

Yes. Every form has its own ClickSyncr for Drip – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator setup, so each can sync to a different campaign with its own API token.

ClickSyncr for Drip – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator Privacy

The plugin sends only the fields you map, and only to Drip. Nothing is collected by ClickSyncr itself. Read about our policy.
